complaints.use_for: Long loading, lag or freezing when editing; poor performance.
Uneasy about storing finances in Google or online.

complaints.theme: Forced survey or upsell to get the file
complaints.use_for: Had to fill a questionnaire or got pushed to a paid service before receiving the download.

complaints.theme: Can't share with family or partner
complaints.use_for: Lock or permissions stop sharing the sheet with others.

complaints.theme: Doesn't track account balances or transfers well
complaints.use_for: Can't see running cash/account balances; transfers between accounts or debit/credit mix throw off numbers.
Has to type, copy-paste or re-enter totals by hand instead of it being automatic.

wishes.use_for: Wants to change the built-in split or method (e.g. 50/30/20 to another ratio).
Wants yearly totals or a full-year overview of spending.
Wants bill due dates or payment reminders built in.
Wants a currency option or custom currency symbol.

wishes.theme: Wants a specific extra tracker or feature
wishes.use_for: Names a feature/tab to add (no-spend days, check register, total debt, per-card amounts, monthly expense sheets, transactions log, separate sheets).

praise.theme: Good for budgeting with a partner
praise.use_for: Easy to share or plan together with a spouse, partner or family.
Likes that data stays on own computer instead of an app.
Praises that it opened fine in Excel, Numbers or another app.
Instant access, fast or easy download/delivery with no problems.
